reason: I run an established centre with staff and my own customers, and a 10% cut on every job plus quoting blind against other shops on price cuts into what I keep by dealing direct. The held payment would help with unpaid jobs, but it does not bring me anything I cannot already get.
objection: If I have to quote blind against my competitors, I lose the margin I have built, and 10% comes off the top of every job I already priced.
would_change_my_mind: Customers I cannot reach any other way, at a commission lower than what I spend to win them myself, with no price-only bidding.
